main_text.p: fancta & catholica,id eft,Italica môstra & Ido-la,quorũ pâtrociniũ Societas noftra peculiari-ter lufcepit,& de quib' per decé iam annos la-boro,ea vt mihi catholica effecta, fancta quoq; facere poffim , defcribere conabor : ex quo tuâ de Societate Iefu & R omana Ecclefia lentcti-am in omnem æternitatem confirmari & cor-roborari fenties.

Alterū igitur horum Idolorū vidi Romæ in phano D.Petri, q Idolum vulgò appellat Vica-rium Christi:ego vero illud vel ipsum Christū,vel quid maius etiā Christo propterea existimabā, quòd omnis populus, qui religionis caussa eò cōfluxerat, simul ac illud in sublimi folio posi-tū manibus rubrorum hominū,Seraphinorum instar angelorum,ne forte ad lapide pedem suū Tsal. sooffenderet,afferri vidit,statim in genua procū-beret, pectus suū tunderet, multaq; id gen' a-lia, q soli Deo conueniût, faceret. Proh Chri-ste sancte,anim"tūc [?] exclamabat meus,quoufq; quæso tibi ferendū videbitur, vt quantū ipse te verus Deus humiliaueris in terris,tantum Vica-ri' tuus,homo dūtaxat,super omnes sese efferat & extollat cœlos? Vt,cùm nullū tu hîc regnum habueris , imò regnum tuum non esse de hoc lom. s.mundo dixeris , nullaque regia vsus maiestate fueris: Vicarius tamen tuus omniū iura possi-deat regnorum,omnesq; reges,teq; etiam Re-gem regum humana diuinaque vincat pompa & maiestate? Vt cùm discipulus tuus Petrus, Ass.r. squi primus Papa fuisse dicitur, Cornelium Centurionem sibi ad pedes ne iacere quidem,

page.notes: Printed marginal notes are short and partly unclear: the note beside "offenderet" reads as "Tful." with a following mark; the note beside "hoc" reads as "Iom." or "lom." with a mark; the note beside "Petrus" reads as "Ass." or "Aff." with a mark. Their exact letters are doubtful and are given as best read. "anim"tūc" is doubtful at the end of "animtūc", where the apostrophe or quotation mark is unclear. The page is a clean scan of a single printed page with no catchword or signature.
